description:
Minimal program (scratchpad s131b/min.fz; elixir prints 1):
    defmodule M do
      def h(0), do: fn x -> x end
      def h(n), do: h(n - 1).(1)
    end
    IO.inspect(M.h(1))
Also: s131/min.fz (prints 1), handoff/closure_elem.fz (Enum.to_list(Stream.map([fn x -> x end], fn f -> f.(1) end)), prints [1]), s131/min_stream.fz (prints [5]).

On a04a618c7 (with fz-sc8.147) each compiles and then fails:
- interp: backend continuation delivery ... backend return layout decoded 0 lane(s), got 1
- run/build: native cannot project captures out of a callable that names no function in Continuation { owner: FnId(N) }
Needed: a recursive call whose return is a union holding a closure, which the caller then calls. The list, the Stream and the free-arrow-variable specialization are not involved.

Cause (verified by probes): both ends of the self-recursive return are produced in produce_named_transport_position (src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs). The recursion edge is cut (cut_in_component_returns), so each end derives its layout from its own type and runtime demand through contract_transport_layout -> callable_layout_from_demand. Both read the same type, int | closure. With no exact direct layout the fallback is the generic callable (function None), carried in a ValueRef lane only when demand.callable.is_first_class(). The callee's return demand has escape: true (ValueRef, one lane); the continuation's resume-payload demand has escape: false (Absent, zero lanes). A generic callable names no function, so zero lanes cannot hold it.

Three producers answer "what layout does this return arrive in" (ExecutableReturn, ReturnPayload, ResumePayload arms), each from its own demand.

Spike (s131b/spike.patch, one line): the fallback also carries the callable when the demand names targets. All four programs match elixir on interp, run and build; lib 2169 passed, 1 pin falls (01068 whole-program activations 207 -> 206).

Fix shape: the generic callable's carrier does not depend on which end of the edge asks. Preferred: a callable that names no function is always carried (the conditional goes away); fall back to the spike's rule only if that raises a pin. Fixtures with elixir oracles on three paths; full gate.
title: A callable returned across a recursion edge arrives in the layout it was sent in
